HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Aspects of integrity? (1 mark)
   A. Say Aspects of integrity has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Aspects of integrity.
   C. Apply the teaching of Aspects of integrity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Aspects of integrity to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Indian Traditional Calendar? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Indian Traditional Calendar.
   B. Use Indian Traditional Calendar to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Indian Traditional Calendar has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Indian Traditional Calendar with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

4. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues of Righteousness. ? (1 mark)

   D. Apply the teaching of Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues of Righteousness.  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

6. Which response best shows understanding of Virtues for righteousness? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Virtues for righteousness.
   B. Apply the teaching of Virtues for righteousness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Virtues for righteousness has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Virtues for righteousness to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Social and National Festivals? (1 mark)
   A. Say Social and National Festivals has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Social and National Festivals to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Social and National Festivals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Social and National Festivals.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o? (1 mark)

9. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)

11. Which response best shows understanding of Social and National festivals 10 8.2. Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The s? (1 mark)
